title: The night bus stopped for someone I could not see 🚌
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 1:55 in the morning the night bus stopped and the driver waited for a passenger nobody could see.

scenes.narration: At 1:55 in the morning the night bus stopped and the driver waited for a passenger nobody could see.
I was the only one aboard. The doors opened at a stop with no shelter, no light and no house for a hundred metres. The driver did not move.
He watched the mirror, and nodded, and said, mind the step, love. The doors stayed open for a long, silent minute, then closed with a sigh.
I asked him who he was talking to. He looked at me in the mirror. He said, the usual lady. She gets on here every night and sits behind you.
I did not turn round. I felt the seat shift. I felt the cold rise along my shoulder, and the smell of old perfume, and something damp.
The driver said, she likes the window seat, so I put the heating on for her. The little display on the dashboard ticked. Passengers, two.
At the next stop the driver opened the doors again and said, this is you, love. I stood up. The cold hand on my sleeve did not let me go.
The driver smiled sadly into the mirror. He said, she has never wanted to get off before. I think she has decided to go home with you.
So tell me. Do you step off the bus, or stay in your seat?
